title.narrative: EU-Brazil Digital Dialogue and Partnership Facility

description.narrative: The Multi-Donor Action EU-BRA Digital Dialogue and Partnership Facility is jointly co-financed by the European Union and the Federal Ministry for Digital and Transport (Bundesministerium für Digitales und Verkehr, BMDV) and implemented by GIZ as part of the BMDV project ¿International Digital Dialogues with Emerging and Developing Countries¿. The Action is part of and contributes to the Team Europe Initiative Brazil ¿ Digital Transformation, described in the Action Document for the 2022 Regional Cooperation Facility for Americas and the Caribbean. The Action aims to support the policy dialogue between the EU and the federal government of Brazil in support of bilateral priorities. The Overall Objective of the Action is to promote the strategic partnership of the EU with Brazil on the digital agenda through dialogue on policy harmonisation and regulatory convergence and cooperation across relevant policies dealing with digital technologies. The Specific Objectives (outcomes) of the Action are 1. A mechanism for policy harmonisation and regulatory convergence is in place steered by the Dialogue on Information Society and Digital Economy (DISDE) and 2. EU-Brazil private sector cooperation on the digital agenda is fostered.
